info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Customer Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Customer Behavior Insights Update API allows businesses to refine and enhance their understanding of customer interactions by updating customer behavior insights based on specific parameters. This operation is particularly useful for customer relationship management, enabling businesses to tailor their services and marketing strategies based on behavior patterns. Typically utilized by customer service teams, marketing analysts, and data scientists, this API supports targeted campaigns and customer retention initiatives. The PATCH method ensures that only the necessary changes to customer behavior records are applied efficiently, maintaining data integrity.

patch.summary: Update customer behavior insight for a specific customer.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the behavior insights for a customer identified by their unique ID. Utilize this endpoint to modify existing insights based on new data or analytics, ensuring that you provide the necessary fields in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update customer behavior insights for a specified customer. The payload contains various fields that represent behavior insights and trends associated with the customer identified by CUST-100045.
